rd-p1.title: Move and Feel Good
rd-p1.text: Sam is running and jumping in the park. He feels great! Moving gives him energy. After the run, he is relaxed and happy. His body is growing too. Move every day and stay active!

rd-p2.title: Heart and Lungs
rd-p2.text: Look at Mia! She is riding her bike up a hill. Her heart is beating fast and she is breathing hard. Her heart and lungs are getting stronger, so she doesn't get tired quickly.

rd-p3.title: Bones and Muscles
rd-p3.text: Leo is at karate class. First, he is stretching his muscles. Then he is jumping and kicking. With strong muscles, he can push and pull. His bones are like a frame for his body. Exercise makes them strong.

rd-p4.title: Race Day
rd-p4.text: It's race day! Ana starts at the gate. She runs around the cone and climbs through the hoop. Next, she goes up the ladder and across the bridge. She slides down the slide. Then she jumps over the hurdles.
